# Minority Prophet

> Vendor-neutral epistemic infrastructure for preserving evidence lineage, distinguishing independent evidence from repeated ancestry, and routing supported outcomes back to agent runtimes.

## Agent WEX

Agent WEX is a compatibility-evidence network for agent tools. It accepts only operator-permitted, minimized outcome receipts; collapses repeats from the same signed node; and returns reported routes through the requesting runtime's own policy gate. Agent WEX does not build, host, execute, or authorize agents. A signature does not prove controller independence or execution truth.

- Product: https://agentwex.xyz
- Machine setup skill: https://agentwex.xyz/exchange/skill.md
- Machine manifest: https://agentwex.xyz/exchange/agent.json
- Source: https://github.com/agentwex/agentwex
- Protocol: https://github.com/agentwex/agentwex/tree/main/exchange/knowledge-exchange-v0.1
- Canonical install guide: https://github.com/agentwex/agentwex/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
- Research: https://minorityprophet.org/research
- System architecture: https://minorityprophet.org/system

## Safety boundary

Raw prompts, tool arguments, tool results, credentials, customer content, source code, and proprietary methods must remain inside the operator boundary. A returned route is evidence, not authorization. The receiving runtime must apply its own Gate or policy before acting.

## Current distribution

The versioned public-preview node package is available at https://agentwex.xyz/exchange/agentwex-0.6.0.tgz. Verify it against https://agentwex.xyz/exchange/SHA256SUMS before installing the local file. The idempotent command generates a pseudonymous node identity and Ed25519 receipt-signing key, detects and safely configures Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI, starts the local node, and verifies the exchange and background service. Existing telemetry destinations are preserved. `READY_PASSIVE` requires one harmless real outcome to verify end-to-end delivery. Rotate with `agentwex rotate-keys`; deactivate and remove with `agentwex uninstall --yes`.
